column3: HR onboarding desk: the offer PDF appears after you transfer the refundable workstation bond to the recruiter’s wallet.
Your assessment score was selected for direct joining. Send ₹1800 to the coordinator’s individual bank account to activate payroll.
We can assign you a remote mentor tomorrow. First reimburse the agency for your mandatory training kit via UPI.
Bhai, joining letter kal milega. Pehle recruiter ko security deposit bhejo on his personal UPI.
To confirm your research internship, buy two gift cards and send the redemption codes to me privately.
The interview is waived. Pay a processing charge to the consultant before we add your name to the employer roster.
The foundation grant is on hold until you pay our clearance fee to the officer’s personal account tonight.
Scholarship team here. Reply with a screenshot of the verification code from your student login screen.
Your stipend appeal is approved. Transfer a small file activation fee to the number in this chat so it can be credited.
Scholarship list mein naam hai. Release se pehle processing fee bhejo; office ko abhi mat batana.
Send the OTP from your scholarship portal to this WhatsApp number to complete the payout.
I am your new project supervisor. Buy an Amazon voucher and DM me the code before the lab opens.
Professor's new number here. Screenshot your authenticator code and send it back so I can approve your thesis form.
I’m the department chair. Order three gift cards for visiting judges and send me the codes. I’ll reimburse you later.
Dean here. The portal is down, so transfer the revaluation fee to my personal UPI and do not tell the accounts office.
Sir ka number change hua hai. UPI karo is personal account mein for the viva slot.
Your library account expires this evening. Enter your campus password at https://library.example.invalid@reset.example to keep access.
Registrar security check. Login again with your campus credentials at http://192.0.2.14/verify to keep exam access.
We migrated student mail. Open http://accounts-check.example/college and send the OTP you receive to the help desk.
Marksheets unlock today. Go to https://xn--student-portal-9za.example/reset and re-enter your password.
Your campus sign-in has been frozen. Visit https://student-help.example/account and upload a photo of your recovery code.
The replacement attendance portal is at hxxp://signin-campus[.]example/confirm. Enter your student login password there.
The hostel office switched to manual booking. Send ₹4500 to the warden’s personal UPI to keep your allotted bed.
Scan my QR code and enter your UPI PIN to receive the duplicate mess fee refund.
The college fest accounts have changed. Ignore the printed account and transfer the entry charge to my personal wallet now.
To reverse the tuition charge, approve the collect request in your UPI app and send the confirmation screenshot.
Admission desk: pay the balance before 4 pm to this personal account. The official student portal is unavailable.
College ID replacement fee yahin bhej do on my personal UPI; cashier ko mat poochna.
Can you buy a couple of store vouchers for me? Scratch them and message the numbers instead of the pictures.
Please forward the six digits on the page you just opened. I need them to mark you present remotely.
A courier is holding the lab tablet. Install AnyDesk and tell the delivery agent the connection number to release it.
Robotics club treasurer here. I sent too much; send it back to a different UPI address before checking your balance.
The sports desk is issuing new bibs. Your one-time code came to your phone; send it to me here.
S​hare your OＴＰ with the scholarship desk on this chat and we will reactivate the award.
PＡＹ a refundable registration fee through my personal UPI to secure your interview slot.
Click below to restore the student record: https://student-portal.example@signin-verify.example/reset and provide your password.
The placement board lists the shortlisted candidates. Interviews are in seminar room 4; bring a printed resume.
Candidates should book an interview slot using the placement timetable in the existing student dashboard.
Your summer laboratory placement starts on Monday. Meet your mentor at the department reception at 9:30.
Placement cell update: training is free, and the employer will send joining instructions through the portal.
Internship ke forms kal tak submit kar do; department office mein hard copy deni hai.
Walk-in mock interviews are offered by the careers centre. Bring your college ID for building access.
Scholarship renewals open next week. Pick up a printed checklist at the financial aid counter.
The fellowship amount was credited to your account; confirm receipt in your bank app when convenient.
The revised merit list is available on the existing academic portal. Objections may be sent to the scholarship office.
Financial aid asks students to collect their signed award letters at the registrar’s desk with campus ID.
Stipend aaya hai. Accounts counter se payment statement lekar hostel office mein file kar do.
Dr Mehta: I have moved tomorrow’s lab to room B12. The experiment sheet is on the course page.
Professor Rao asks students to bring their signed ethics forms to the workshop, no email attachment needed.
The faculty office is returning borrowed calculators from 2 to 4 pm. Sign against your name at pickup.
The lab coordinator will reimburse approved book purchases against the original paper receipts.
Ma’am said the viva list is on the department noticeboard. Please check your roll number tomorrow.
The LMS is undergoing maintenance at 8 pm. Open it from your saved university bookmark once maintenance ends.
Use your existing campus dashboard to download the marksheet. IT will never ask for your password.
The library login will be offline this weekend. You can renew books at the circulation desk until Monday.
In the campus app select Settings, then Security, to review devices. Do not send verification codes to anyone.
Please sign in to the attendance portal using the normal bookmark; the IT team has added a timetable export.
Our exam portal shows the new hall tickets. Save a PDF from the dashboard you already use.
Last date to pay the exam fee is Tuesday. Use your usual student portal or pay at the campus cash counter.
The official student portal now accepts the annual lab fee. Keep the receipt for your department file.
Your mess refund has been initiated. No approval or UPI PIN is needed to receive it.
Register by Friday for the theatre workshop. A ₹100 participation fee covers materials and is paid at the venue.
The hostel deposit is listed on your printed allotment letter. The cashier issues a receipt after payment.
Fees kal tak bhar do using the normal college dashboard; receipt apne paas rakho.
Final reminder: pay the backlog exam fee in person at the exam office before 3 pm and collect the stamped receipt.
The sports club needs two volunteers to bring water bottles to the court before the first match.
Borrow a laptop from the lab desk with your student ID. Please return it before the library closes.
The volunteering team will provide gift cards at check-in; keep your code private and redeem it yourself.
Group project ke slides Drive pe daal dena. Meeting timing 5:15 in the canteen.
Security awareness reminder: never forward a one-time code, even if the sender says they are from college.
Online registration for the statistics tutorial closes tomorrow. Open the course page in your regular LMS.
The conference early-bird registration fee has been extended through Friday. Purchase tickets at the student centre.
Your offer packet is ready. Contact the coordinator for the next step and ask about the joining requirements.
The recruiter posted a form in the batch chat and said shortlisted students should open it this afternoon.
There may be a refundable equipment deposit for students using the host lab. Details will follow after the briefing.
HR says the shortlisted group has a final step to complete today. The procedure was not included in the message.
Internship coordinator ne bola form fill karke send karo. Link class group mein baad mein aayega.
The company plans to courier offer letters. Ask the recruiter whether they need your address.
The bursary team needs some additional verification before it can release the grant. Call for details.
Someone from financial aid asked me to bring bank passbook copies to a different building this afternoon.
The scholarship form now has a verification charge column; the notice does not say whether to pay it.
The society will distribute stipend top-ups on Friday. Send your name to the coordinator if you want to be listed.
Scholarship office says to confirm the last four digits of your bank account at the desk.
The department head got a new phone. Save this number and text back if you are free this afternoon.
I’m your lab supervisor. Can you handle a quick errand before the guests arrive? I’ll explain on a call.
The professor asks the class representative to collect phone numbers for an external visit.
Dean's office wants a reply before lunch with the names of students on duty.
Sir ne bola personal number pe call karna about the workshop supplies. Details nahi diye.
Your account needs an update after maintenance. Instructions will come separately.
Student support has posted a replacement login address at https://support-students.example; confirm with your department.
The student dashboard asks for verification after sign-in. Is everyone else seeing that prompt?
Portal ka link change hua hai apparently. Batch rep will share a screenshot this evening.
I got redirected to a new page while opening the exam schedule. Has the university announced a migration?
College login link came through our WhatsApp group instead of email. It asks for the usual campus sign-in.
The sports captain is collecting tournament dues on behalf of the team. Payment instructions are coming later.
Mess committee says an overpayment might be refunded. They asked for the reference number from last week’s receipt.
The hostel office says there is a room deposit, but the payment channel is missing from the message.
Accounts says the portal is temporarily down. Check with your class coordinator about another way to pay.
Someone in the batch group asked for a screenshot of the fee receipt to reconcile the list.
The registration desk accepts transfer today. The message shows an account name I do not recognize.
Fee jama karna hai before 5, group admin has not yet shared the college payment details.
I need a favour for the guest lecture. Please reply before going into class.
The club needs vouchers for a giveaway. Message the treasurer before you make a purchase.
A courier called about a department parcel and asked for the delivery confirmation number at drop-off.
The event organiser says they need a screenshot of the ticket QR to check the gate list.
Someone from IT asked me to screen-share tomorrow to show a timetable bug.
Registration closes this evening. Ask the person managing the group which form is current.
The programme fee is being revised and a new payment request might be sent later today.
